subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• 1879: American naval officer George W. De Long and a small crew embarked on an expedition to the Arctic aboard the USS Jeannette.
• 1880: The Jeannette became trapped in pack ice before eventually being crushed and sinking in 1881.
• 1881: After grueling journeys across the ice and open sea, only a portion of the crew survived to be rescued.
• 1938: Historian Nathan Whitfield published a book titled Into the Frozen North: The Jeannette Expedition.
• 2007: Filmmaker Chien-Shiung Wu released a documentary called The Lost Voyage of the Jeannette.
• 2023: Sonar surveys identified what researchers believe to be the wreckage of the Jeannette in the Laptev Sea.
prompt: The student wants to provide a historical overview of the Jeannette expedition. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: Setting out in 1879 for the Arctic, De Long and his crew endured grueling journeys across ice and open sea, including the loss of their ship in 1881, before a portion of the crew was rescued later that same year.
choices.B: In 1879, the De Long expedition sailed to the Arctic, where, in 1881, they rescued the surviving crew of a ship that had been crushed in the ice, the Jeannette (the wreckage of which was identified in 2023).
choices.C: The Jeannette expedition has inspired a 1938 book, a 2007 documentary, and a 2023 discovery.
choices.D: Nathan Whitfield wrote about the history of De Long's 1879–81 expedition in the book Into the Frozen North: The Jeannette Expedition (1938); decades later, in 2007, Chien-Shiung Wu released a documentary about the voyage.

explanation:
Choice A is the best answer. The sentence provides a historical overview of the Jeannette expedition, noting that De Long and his crew set out for the Arctic in 1879, lost their ship in 1881, and that a portion of the crew was rescued that same year.

Why B is incorrect:

Choice B is incorrect. The sentence misrepresents information from the notes; De Long and his crew were themselves the ones in need of rescue in 1881—they weren't rescuing the crew of another ship.
